title: Hunger Games: approved sequence, source boundaries and funded arena proposals
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: approved sequencing reconciled; source/read/runtime and authored arena boundaries corrected
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual review covers312lines, HG1–HG43, seven engine-fact rows, C1–C10, every source/search/review/gap table, WER1–WER17/S1–S6, T-HG1/X1–X4/HG-S1/HG-S2 and M1–M8. Book totals580816and selected135467words sum correctly: one whole first book plus three selected later-book windows, not23percent of every book. Source catalogue prefixes identify supplied editions; integrity/spine extraction, reader labels, coordinator source checks and adopted game rules remain distinct. Seven table groups are marked reopened and two explicitly not reopened; a headline nine opens is a historical invocation claim, not nine independently confirmed table rows. No raw book body or live holdings was newly checked here.

F2: USER_VISION's November4 horizon record explicitly preserves approval of five sequencing changes including this slice after current LOTM-first work. It does not approve the whole horizon, lift WR9, license a download, or accept every proposed arena/exception. Update the master's stale approval question and its obsolete Hunger Games lacks-institution-doc example; retain unproved foundations/current-runtime claims as dated snapshots. This is owner reconciliation, not new gameplay dispatch or commit authorization. The institution pass's own approval statement has a matching user-direction owner, rather than relying on an agent's assertion.

F3: The source's tessera entry weights, current count versus cumulative years, participants versus opponents, eligible volunteering and era-specific victors/student mentors remain separate. Law, tolerated poaching, official starvation records, body condition, private belief and propaganda differ. Exact B4/B5 openings do not establish absence of later sponsor systems or all-era entitlements. HG24's B5:L1168 is outside W12's1–348 coverage and stays an unreviewed locator lead. C9's pack discrepancy remains unopened; self-report versus shown skill and intended fence duty versus actual electricity are compatible observations. Claims about all of B1 lacking a rule need a source question, not a new verified absence.

F4: Audience attention, actual donor funds, mentor mediation, affordability, available stock, delivery, intended recipient, received item and inferred gift message are distinct. A public spectacle can motivate aid without directly paying a gift. Pooling coins in the cited district gift is Katniss's guess. Source quotes do not fund an authored sponsor ledger; sponsor and Gamemaker consumers can read related evidence without one magic number replacing their actors. A former ally's death does not automatically create a redirected gift or another actor's grudge. Reduction in lottery odds is risk mitigation, not a secured exit from a draw. Keep funding, custody and actor reasons explicit.

F5: Source reaping/arena carry restrictions are not universal world-crossing laws or automatic civilian/Academy currency wipes. Quiet arrival does not guarantee no observer notices. Pre-arena schedule, scenario context, ordinary civilian life, selected arena body/skill and later aftermath stay distinct. No supernatural rank ladder does not mean ordinary survival, biotech and institutional systems are absent. Exact-term code searches cannot prove missing equivalent seams; zero-hit names and unread analogous code establish current consumer/proof gaps rather than mandatory fresh modules. AD51 favors inspecting shared seams before selecting a mechanism.

F6: Preserve the proposed three-day1440x900arena, four different-means routes, nonlethal near-end, actual warning/stock/clock/aftercare, persistence checks and source/canon distinctions. BHR16 retains comfortable ordinary unfed play; hunger-lethal exception lacks specific recorded direction. BHR18 retains reviewable away boundaries; source deaths do not bypass that policy. AD50's open reasonable plans and capable counterplay remain distinct from a fixed answer list. Public trigger examples are nonbinding authoring candidates; HG-S1/HG-S2 remain ID/route/status only until actual private truth is authored, without claiming a playable secret or discovery path already exists. Original geography and abstract rivals are this proposal, not unavoidable source-derived implementation requirements. No native/browser/build/runtime/save/human proof, new source reading, worker, acquisition, delete/move, commit or push occurs.
reviews.evidence: Complete312-line input read in four untruncated chunks; USER_VISION7280–7296, master532–560 and DOMAIN_RULES61–69 are scoped supporting reads. No new source bodies or runtime inspection.
reviews.reopen: Retain unreviewed ranges and inspect actual shared consumers; approved sequence does not grant hunger-lethal exception or certify proposed slice.

folds.heading: ## Hunger Games sequencing and evidence reconciliation B607
folds.body: The [Hunger Games institution pass](worlds/HUNGER_GAMES_INSTITUTIONS_ROLES_AND_SUBTLE_DETAILS_2026-11-04.md#content-reconciliation-b607-approved-sequencing-and-arena-evidence) exists and contains bounded source review, WER proposals and an unbuilt AD50 arena plan. [Recorded user direction](USER_VISION.md#long-term-horizon-world-enablement-and-complexity-2026-11-04) approves the five named sequencing changes after LOTM-first work, without adopting this entire horizon, world details, acquisition or a hunger-lethal exception. B607 resolves that stale approval question from the actual owner. Difficulty remains unknown without selected implementation/play evidence, even with a source doc. Existing code search is lexical and partly unread: inspect applicable shared seams before declaring every proposed mechanism a new module. Audience attention, real gift funding, broker choice, delivery and Gamemaker response remain separate consumers. Continue actual current PROJECT order; this fold launches no build or worker.

scope: Reviewer supplied content dispositions. Explicit read_mode distinguishes fresh reading from inspected prior full-content review reused on unchanged inputs. No hash-inferred semantics or renewed historical behavior proof.

post_record_amendments.from: a dead ally leaves a gift redirected to you or a grudge (HG26)
post_record_amendments.to: a later actor may redirect a funded gift or form a grudge for a supported reason; neither follows automatically from death (HG26)

post_record_amendments.from: the audience-attention number rises with spectacle, so the cheap time is early and the cost is performing for the camera (HG6, S B1:L1737)
post_record_amendments.to: spectacle may attract donors, but actual available funds, mentor choice, priced stock and delivery determine the gift; attention alone is not payment (HG6, S B1:L1737)

post_record_amendments.from: the audience notices spectacle; a quiet crossing is not noticed
post_record_amendments.to: audience/camera or other observers notice by their actual means; a quiet crossing is not guaranteed unnoticed

post_record_amendments.from: | WER9 what carries | memories and cheat; a token, no money | same | same | same |
post_record_amendments.to: | WER9 what carries | world crossing uses its declared method; arena intake separately restricts carried gear/token | same, with selected-era intake | declared crossing and Academy property, not automatic arena confiscation | declared crossing and household property, not automatic arena confiscation |

post_record_amendments.from: Each absent seam is a new mechanism, not a data row.
post_record_amendments.to: The lexical search does not determine whether a seam needs new code, shared-seam adaptation or world data; inspect producer/state/consumer before selecting work.

post_record_amendments.from: exits: a volunteer, a tessera choice, bribery of an official as seen in B5:L291, or leaving the district, which the travel ban makes costly
post_record_amendments.to: possible routes: qualified volunteering, a supported negotiated intervention, or costly escape; a tessera choice changes odds rather than securing an exit, and B5:L291 bribery remains reader-level evidence

post_record_amendments.from: The truth for each is to be authored in the gitignored private pack at build time
post_record_amendments.to: The public trigger examples above are nonbinding proposals, not selected HG-S2 truth. The truth for each ID is to be authored in the gitignored private pack at build time

post_record_amendments.from: Items that change current sequencing (LOTM first, canon-first) and need Weibao's yes: S8 pack save, H2 rewind, Hunger Games slice, the making donor, D&D d20 layer.
post_record_amendments.to: The five sequencing changes, S8 pack save, H2 rewind, Hunger Games slice, the making donor and D&D d20 layer, were approved after current LOTM-first work in [USER_VISION](USER_VISION.md#long-term-horizon-world-enablement-and-complexity-2026-11-04). The rest of the horizon remains proposed.

post_record_amendments.from: Worlds without a design or institutions doc (Hunger Games, Percy Jackson, Earthsea) rate difficulty as unknown, not low.
post_record_amendments.to: World difficulty stays unknown without selected implementation evidence. Hunger Games now has an [institution pass and unbuilt arena plan](worlds/HUNGER_GAMES_INSTITUTIONS_ROLES_AND_SUBTLE_DETAILS_2026-11-04.md); document existence alone is not a low-difficulty rating.
